t: Put up the missing person posters on 6 special pillars.

I have a request for you, . A person is missing, and I ask you to help us search for them. Please put up missing person posters all over the city. Pay attention to all people around you. Together we can find this person and return him to his loved ones.

I believe in the power of unity and solidarity!

Let's join forces and make our world a better place for everyone. Thank you for your attention and support.
Have you put up the posters? Excellent, this will help our search!

It's no wonder our people have taken up arms! There are twisted creatures all around! And ghosts of various monsters! There's no living with them...

We don't have enough Spark energy as it is, and now they're stealing from us...

, maybe you can help? The worst ones right now are the evil eyes - the Searing Eyes, that is! If you thin their numbers a little, we'll breathe easier here!
There are still too many Searing Eyes!
Oh, thank you so much! I see the rumors are true, and you can be counted on... Perhaps you can help me with something else? We students barely scrape by.
Retrieve Raskolnikov's belongings that he gave away to other students.

There is a sick friend of mine, also a student, in the student quarter... He has been feeling unwell for some time, and now he has collapsed with a fever... They are doing renovations now, so we are forced to spend time outside, and he has nothing - he has given everything to his fellow students. , perhaps you could collect his things while I look after him?
Rodion keeps giving away his things!
Oh, at least we'll have a kettle - to boil water... Look at him. He's getting worse.

So, what medicine do we have? There are antipyretics and antihistamines... There is also a thermometer and hot drinks...

, maybe we should try to cure him? We can't wait for a doctor...
He's feeling better now... But... do you smell that? Is that smoke?

Someone started this fire! But who...? Okay, now is not the time to think about it, we need to put out the fire! I happen to have a fire extinguisher here, but be careful,  – it requires Spark energy!

Hurry, before we all burn!
The fire is out... It wasn't accidental!

Today I was informed of a new threat – fire at the university of our city. This incident requires our immediate intervention and joint efforts. My wife Julia, whom I both fear and admire, helped me understand that sometimes you need to go beyond your beliefs and act in the interests of society.

So I ask you, , to help us put out the fires at the university and save students and teachers. May your courage and determination help us overcome this challenge and restore safety in our city.
Are the fires out? Something is always happening over there... We asked them if it's going to blow up. They said, "It shouldn't!"
Find 12 pieces of evidence of arson by collecting fragments of leaflets or taking them from nihilist students, and by questioning 4 influential students.

Yes, it was no accident! Someone set the fire! Of course, I have no idea who... But lately we've had a lot of discussions. Everyone is suggesting something, everyone wants something... , maybe you should find out what's going on and who could be the culprit?

I'm afraid my friend Rodion Raskolnikov might be involved in this...

As for the murderer you're looking for, let Petrov check those who owed her... I can't think of anything else.
Alice? Verkhovensky?! Alarming news... We have checked everyone who owed her.
Investigate rumors of a conspiracy among students by finding 12 letter fragments and interviewing 4 of the most influential students.

, today I'm asking you to help us solve a mystery. The police department in our city reports that university students are planning something that could affect the future of our society. Personally, I believe the students are innocent, but as city officials, we are forced to respond...

I ask you to help us learn what they are planning. Together we can understand this and make the right decision that will benefit us all.
Is that so? This is very interesting, we will continue surveillance...
Life is hard in our city... you'd do many things to get some bread...
It wasn't just arson! It's the dawn of a rebellion! Glory to Alice!
h: What do you know about the arson?

t: Long live the revolution! Soon we will overthrow the dark goddess!
Soon we will strike again! Praise the Awakened!
h: What do you know about the conspiracy?

t: Use the jetpack to get onto the rooftops and catch 7 runaway kittens, then return them to Lydia Charsky.

Oh, dear! I have a problem, !

The thing is, I love cats - I just adore these little fluff balls... But my landlord forbids pets in the apartment...

And just imagine - yesterday he threw them out into the street, and they all climbed onto the roofs... How do I get them back now?

Maybe you can help me? The guys here put together a jetpack, so it's easy as pie to get to the top. Try catching them one by one.
Oh, thank you so much! I'm not brave enough to hop from roof to roof myself! All the kittens are safe now, yay!
Use the jetpack to get onto the rooftops and catch 7 runaway kittens, then return them to Lydia Charsky.

Today we have another task. Student Lydia Charsky asks us to find her runaway kittens! The kittens are on the roofs, and they need our help. I ask you to collect these cute little creatures and return them to their owner, .

Even in such small things as saving kittens, we can show kindness to others. Let's join forces and do a good deed together. Thank you for your willingness to help and for your kind heart. Together we can overcome any difficulties.
Have you found all the kittens? That's great news!

Today we face a new threat - ghostly Searing Eyes that terrorize our city, attacking innocent passers-by. These creatures are filled with malice and a thirst for destruction, and we cannot allow them to continue their atrocities.

I ask you, , to help us defeat these monsters and restore peace in our city. We must join forces and show these Eyes that there is no place for evil and destruction in our city.

Thank you for your willingness to help and for your kind heart. Let us act together and put an end to this evil.
Are the Searing Eyes gone? Excellent news!
Eliminate 9 nihilists at the police station.

That's all great, , but as you can see, we have other problems here. An angry mob is storming the police station, and it looks like we don't have enough people.

Maybe you could help us fight them off, because if they break in here, we won't be able to talk, will we?

If you could thin their numbers a bit... our guys will do the rest.

Excellent!

Now, to business... What do we have here? There are two sweet girls, two goddesses. One is the soul of our world, the other is the ruler of Darkness and the current sovereign of Sarnaut.

The dispute between these sisters is lost somewhere in the darkness of the aeons. One was given the ability to create, the other was not, so she rebelled.

Since then, they have been feuding, envying each other - which is fine and all, but it affected everyone. We died at some point when the Great Mages made a mistake, and you are people of the present time. And then some of us came back to life and others never did. Perhaps my world and your world could find common ground... But the dear sisters would not let us - they have already set us against each other.

They will not listen to me, but maybe they will listen to you?
Eliminate 9 nihilists at the police station.

, today I want to entrust you with something that my beloved wife Julia must not know about...

We are facing a new challenge – a riot of nihilist revolutionaries at the police station of our city. These madmen are trying to violate law and order, threatening the safety of our citizens... And while my wife believes that these nihilists are quite harmless, I disagree!

I'm especially perturbed by their leader, a certain Pyotr Verkhovensky, who has a strong influence on Julia...

We must help our police!
The riot has been suppressed? Great, another week or two of calm.

Ah, most honorable sirlady!! Here you are... in our land... Well, let's talk, fathermother! Or maybe you don't like to be called most honorable sirlady and... fathermother...Please don't consider it familiarity...
Go down to the prison below the police station and interrogate the four captured nihilists.

But that's just one problem!

Let's get back to our rebels... You are probably wondering who's the killer, ? Yes, that friend of yours, Rodion Raskolnikov, did it...

He once wrote an article that there are "nonentities" and "people", and of course he counted himself among the latter...

Maybe you could talk to him? If he confesses to you, we'll be more lenient... We might even release him on bail, but with condition not to leave Jigran.

You can question others, too...

Perhaps all these great people... Teps, Nezebs, Rabulions – are not as great as we thought? We are shocked by great crimes, disturbed by hecatombs, but maybe this evil was caused by another great entity? Or is it just a bloodsucking spider in the center of its web? Flick it away – and it's gone.
Let us celebrate the emancipation of women!
Find out what Rodion Raskolnikov can do for you as a companion.

Porfiry allowed me to go into town – to work off my sins, so to speak. And he asked you, , to accompany me.

Well – I need to redeem myself, so I'm ready. There is still a lot of bad in our capital – and if we sort this out, the townspeople will respect us.

Does that sound good? First, let's teach a few nihilist comrades a lesson...

Well, have we dealt with our nihilist comrades? Our townspeople are not fools either: they see who their enemy is, who burned their houses and caused destruction. But it's not just nihilists – there are also distorted creatures and hostile ghosts – they all harm the townspeople, and if you and I deal with them, your reputation will improve quickly.
Find Aisa in the catacombs and help Alyosha trap her using the destinies stolen by her.

Pathetic fool! Look where he ended up! Can he talk about the greatness of others? The greatness of mortals who put themselves in the place of gods? Those who heard the music of the universe and understood the true plan of the Creator?

But enough – we are close to our goal. The Order of Stars was rightfully proud of the wisdom they had collected - the repositories of the Arshez monasteries contained more than just tomes from the Conclave's libraries. The Order studied the legacy of Zem… of Tep himself!

I know a secret ritual that can trap Aisa, albeit for a short time. I have waited a long time for this, and now we have no other choice. Let's go, !
Don't hesitate! The captive is in safe hands, and with her help I will figure out how to fix everything and put things right!
Perhaps right now I'm closer than ever to getting answers to my questions...
Hear Hiero out and learn what is going on from Marianne and Negus Tot

So... We are here thanks to you, . That's the only reason I'm forgiving all your faults.

You summoned the Children of Light to this world - and they arrived. They will help us, protect us from the Darkness. But we need to help our saviors save us. So we must act.

As long as we are here, Hirkalla's power is not absolute.

As long as we are here, the Darkness has not won.

As long as we are here, there is hope.

The strength of our faith sustains the shield around the Cathedral. We are the edge of the sword aimed at the dark goddess's black heart. And we shall strike. Talk to Marianne and Negus Tot - here they don't need to worry about being overheard.

You heard their words. The great power of Faith is our salvation...

But the Darkness is seeking ways to destroy it, trying to tempt us... You can help us.
Chase the ghosts away from the Cathedral.

The Goddess of Darkness confuses Sarnaut with her false miracles, . She claims to have power over life and death, that she can revive the fallen... many believed that.

But only the Light can grant true resurrection. Hirkalla created a multitude of shadows, just ghosts of once living people - and now these false entities have surrounded the Cathedral. They are tempting our warriors and scaring citizens.

There's nothing we can do for them now - so I order you to chase them away.
The Sanctuary of Light is not a place for lost souls!
The Children of Light told me that the dead will resurrect in other worlds if the Light wills it. If their sins are too great, they must atone for them in the palaces of Ganzir.
Eliminate 12 ghosts of citizens and the Count Nulin.

Danas says we need to weaken the enemy... You and I have worked hard, but there are still things that need doing...

There are many ghosts around the Cathedral who do not believe our empress. They believe the Light can help them. These fools are feeding the barrier.

A certain Count Nulin has an influence on them - a well-known rogue who has seemingly repented.

Anyway, kill a dozen ghosts and the Count along with them. This will weaken the shield. Then report back to Danas.
Are there are fewer ghosts around the Cathedral? Great, that means less faith is needed to maintain the shield. But our work is not done yet. We will continue.

Watch, ! There are enough living creatures on Jigran - those who live here and those who just arrived.

Their combined faith protects everyone, but unlike us they are weak and full of doubts, fatigue, and disappointment.

But the Light won't leave them in the lurch. Remind them of that and bestow my blessing.
Their faith is stronger now - at least for the time being. We must be understanding towards their weaknesses - they are just simple warriors and civilians who have never seen what we have.
Sow doubt in the minds of 12 civilians or Paladins.

The Shield of Faith is nearly impenetrable to us, . It's powered by faith in the Light and hopes for a better future. And the power of our dark mistress has always faltered before irrational conviction.

Fortunately, the Wanderer knows what to do. We have already sown doubt among the leaders of the Paladins. Let's do the same with regular soldiers and civilians.

Use the pages from this book. No one will know what you are doing.

A dozen targets should do. Report back to Danas afterwards.
Well, it's not my method, but if this is our goal, why not use the opportunity? I hope they'll realize that their cause is doomed to failure.
Light the candles in the Cathedral

, I myself witnessed resurrection on Kirah. I knew then that knowledge without faith is fruitless. Now, as I manage the largest scientific institute in Sarnaut, I'm trying to share this insight with my brethren. My people, the people of Zem, had the opportunity to witness the power of Light in action.

So I suggest performing simple rituals that will strengthen the faith of the people here. Because symbols are important.

Light these candles before the icons of martyrs and apostles of our Church. A small action - a great result.
The light of candles will dispel the darkness in our souls...

If I had proper tools, I could measure how much your actions strengthened the shield of faith.

But I can only rely on irrational confidence.
Is there anything the power of Light can't do?
Collect the energy of Sparks, then purchase Sparkboom from Sarang Kido.

What do you think, ?

A whole Cathedral of saints, each more righteous than the last... I always thought Negus Tot was a little crazy, but now...

Ah, well. What matters now is that it works.

I suppose you don't know me. And I know you quite well. Why? I had a sister, Sarbaz Sais. Do you understand now?

I'm not going to avenge her - she chose her own path. I'll just tell you this: you can't trust the Light or the Darkness. Trust no one but yourself.

I want you to test something. Will you do it?

Very well! Now this Sparkton Pack is yours. Not the latest model, but I'm sure you'll get your hands on a more powerful replacement in no time.

Use this one until then.

Distorted creatures are one of our biggest problems right now, .

All these nasty creatures like the Gargoyles have flooded the city and started attacking the residents. It's not good. We need to do something.

Let's deal with them. The Gargoyles are a great target - right now there's a bunch of them near the Cathedral.

Kill a dozen, then report to Naira.
Well done! Gargoyles don't care about our barricades - they can easily fly to the city center. I'd grab a bow and go hunting myself. But for now - thank you!

The Paladins aren't sitting idly either, . We are trying to undermine their authority - and they are doing the same to us. We know there has been a delivery of pamphlets containing all sorts of sedition and defamation of our mistress.

We need to understand what exactly the Paladins are saying - then we'll know how to oppose this.

Collect a few leaflets and take them to Naira.

Well, it's quite clever and funny! If you want to reduce someone's importance - ridicule them. Although the mistress might want to see this one herself... There are even obscene pictures here...

Thank you, let's see what else they come up with.
Clear the beacons of darkness and eliminate the distorted Gargoyles.

As I've already told you, , the Light is spread throughout the city using special beacons that dispel darkness with bright rays. This gift of faith ignites burning hatred among all the nasty creatures awakened by the dark goddess.

We call them "distorted" - the creatures of darkness attracted by the energy of Sparks. They are dangerous both to the living and the dead.

Now the distorted Gargoyles are attacking our beacons. If they are extinguished, another part of the city will be lost to the darkness. I'll give you a special relic that will destroy the creatures and clear the beacon.

It's a dangerous mission, but I believe you can handle it. One of the Children of Light, Ieziphael, can help you reach the beacons. Talk to him.
I've heard a lot about you. The hero who saved Sarnaut more than once. And here you are standing in front of me.
Ask Alyosha about the fate of the awakened.

I'm Alyosha, one of the novices in the Order of Stars. We are on a mission here: we help the ghosts that have yet to come back to life. They are called the Awakened, because Hirkalla roused them from a centuries-long sleep.

Their situation is quite grim, and very few people are willing to help them.

If you are here, , perhaps you can help us?

There are scarier things... The madman dwelling under the city... that abducts people. We should question those who might know something about it and help the others in need.

We thought Alice would save us... yes, she was here... But she has her own agenda, and the fates of the awakened are not her concern.
Find out about missing ghosts from knowledgeable people.

, I have an idea: ask those who may know something about the missing. I think there are four such people.

First of all, my brother Dmitry - he knows many people here and he travels often - I'm sure he has heard something.

Then there's Agrafena Svetlova who is called Grushenka here. She is a woman of dubious reputation, of course, but she lends money to people and has a lot of connections. And the ghosts trust her.

There is also Selifan... The coachman of one of the visiting businessmen. His work takes him all over the neighborhood, so I'm sure he has a lot to say.

And finally, the director of the visiting circus is a certain George. The circus is a crowded place, so who would know more than him?

I'm sure they will all want something in return, but I suppose you are used to it.
The slums need your help more than ever!

Ah, everything makes sense now, my friend!

We've learned a lot - now we need to talk to Chichikov, a buyer of dead souls!

My lordlady, I've come to you with a request... There is more and more trouble in our neighborhood, and the most serious one is... ahem... spiders. Yes, it's a nuisance - these terrible creatures trap us, the awakened ones, in their nets and drain our energy.

Someone might say it's part of their nature... But I'll be honest - I find it revolting. So if you want to help, I'm asking you to eliminate this vermin.

I've never liked spiders, let alone such huge ones...

Thank you! Perhaps we should send Smerdyakov to see how Grushenka is doing... Oh, Grushenka...

As for your question, I heard that a certain Chichikov is buying up dead souls. Sparks, that is. Perhaps he's involved in the disappearances?

We have received a complaint, ! From the townspeople... They say spiders are everywhere... But I can already see that myself!

They say there are too many of them on the outskirts.  In short, something needs to be done. I suggest you kill a dozen distorted spiders, maybe there will be fewer of them...

Report the results to the guy who complained. What's his name...? Dmitry Karamazov, right.
Oh, well, at least someone heard us... Honestly, it's a nightmare - these spiders just keep coming...
Eliminate mosquitoes and give the Sparks to ghosts.

! Are you from Mitya? No?! From Alyosha?! Very interesting...

Yes, alas, no one wants us here... And since you want to help, then I'll entrust you with one little task...

Everything we have now revolves around Sparks and their energy. Some buy Sparks, others sell them... some steal them. Among them are dumb creatures - ghostly mosquitoes. If one of those latches onto an awakened one - there'll be nothing left of them but the Spark.
So I ask you - kill the soulsuckers, then release the energy to those who desperately need it.

Well, the job is done, which means the contract is fulfilled.

So Alyosha wants to find out about the missing ghosts? Yes, I've heard about it. It happens at night: as soon as midnight hits, they vanish one by one. After all, the city was built above another city, so there are all sorts of tunnels down there...

I've also heard that a businessman showed up lately offering to buy other people's Sparks... Maybe he is to blame for this?

If only distorted creatures were our only problem! It's not just people who came back as ghosts - there are creatures, too. Even insects like gnats.

And our townspeople are complaining again - they are sick of ghostly mosquitoes. They want us to deal with this vermin...

In short, that's why the order is to exterminate a dozen mosquitoes. You will report to Agrafena Svetlova when you are done, she is an authority among the ghostly townsfolk.
Are there fewer sparksuckers? That's great. Otherwise they suck the warmth of the unfortunate...
Get a box of wine for Selifan.

I have a problem, ... As soon as I came back to life, things kept getting worse. I was loading a crate of wine and dropped it. Everything is in pieces...

The owner will be so angry. "Selifan, you idiot," he'll say. "You botched such a simple task..." He'll have me flogged! It's deserved, of course, but perhaps it can still be fixed?

I have a friend, Zlatan - he sells fried meat near the circus. He got the same crate...

Perhaps you can work something out with him? Get me the crate, and I'll tell you all the rumors...
Well, what did Zlatan say? Did you come to an agreement?

Oh, you are just in time, the master would have discovered the loss soon...

Well, I owe you...

Yes, our master buys up dead souls, but no one knows why he needs them... You'd better ask him yourself.

People come here with various requests, . And it looks like we must do everything... Oh well. If the empress wants her subjects to be happy, so be it.

Anyway, a certain Zlatan asks for boar meat... He says the living need to eat something, too...

Well, if he needs it - we'll get it. Go where these wild boars are and bring him a few carcasses for his kebab. Report to him afterwards.
Ooh, buddy, I knew they'd send you! I owe you.

! Hey, hey, no need to swing your fists here!

I know Messere had an agreement with you... and we are, to some extent, allies.

Here they know me as George, the great impresario who brought entertainment to this dull land... And you seem to need information...

The thing is this: I had one very smart dog, called Chestnut because of the color... You see, someone scared the poor thing, and she ran away. If you find her, I'll help you!

You'd drive anyone to the grave...

If I tell you, will you leave me alone? Listen, a lot of mysterious things are going on here - a time traveler is weaving conspiracies, and the black monk is not as ordinary as you think.

I'm not Elleken, but I've seen a lot in my life. Believe me, new players have entered the game. We observe, we want to understand, but without Messere we cannot help you.
Find the right dog for Pulcinella by bringing 12 different dogs.

, we received a complaint. A certain George, the owner of the circus, complains that his dog is missing, says he can't find her.

He says some hero tried to help him but was too incompetent to find the dog.

You aren't like this, are you? Will you help the artist? Find him a dozen dogs - let him pick one.
Oh, Great Darkness - I'm so sick of you... Begone!
Distribute the excess energy among 8 ghostly citizens.

, the empress wants to ease the lot of those who have not yet been resurrected... Of course, we won’t be able to resurrect them right now - but what’s stopping you from showing a little generosity?

Let's distribute some energy. We won't lose much, and they'll see what awaits them in the future.

The energy will allow them to feel alive for a short time.

You will report to Agrafena Svetlova afterwards - she has been asking us to help the ghosts for a while.
Are you done with the task?
Oh, wonderful - praise the Empress for her generosity. We will await further resurrection!
Find the Paladins' agent among Hirkalla's officials.

, we have a problem - it looks like we have a mole. Not some animal that digs in the ground, but a real traitor who passes the empress's secrets to her enemies. We will not tolerate this!

One thing is known for sure - this black sheep among our officials has now gone to the circus to hand over the information to another agent.

Find the traitor, deal with them, and bring the ciphered message to Dmitry Karamazov... He is in our service, so he'll know what to do.
Wow, another cipher... Okay, we'll keep it... All that matters is that they keep paying my salary. Because I need money to woo Grushenka.
What? How dare you?! This is an insult!
h: I'm looking for a Paladin spy, is that you?

t: Greetings! My colleagues and I decided to go to the circus...
I've heard a lot about him - he came to our city, started buying up people's Sparks... For what? We need to find out. , we should ask openly - let him tell us what he wants, the scoundrel...

Whaaat? Missing ghosts?

I had nothing to do with this, I assure you! My task is simple - buy new goods if an opportunity presents itself. After all, these are just Sparks - they don't care who owns them.

In the end, everyone wants to live - to become stronger and... more alive, so to speak. This depends on how many Sparks you have.

I think you have already realized that it's a profitable business...
Persuade the owners to release the souls

Am I the only one buying dead souls? Look around you - there are lots of the living who have Sparks in spades...

I can tell you who they are. I wanted to buy the Sparks from them, but since you are here... I suppose we should rid them of the excess.
Oh, people! They don't like dying from natural causes!
Terrible people. Don't you agree? And how am I supposed to deal with such people... Well, thanks to you I have less competition now.
Find out what's hiding in the catacombs.

So much happened while you were away, . Your friend Alice showed up... She and Alyosha went after that mysterious monster you were looking for. They said it was somewhere under the city...

But I haven't heard from them in a while. Perhaps you should see if they need help?

Phew, I'm starting to hate dungeons...

So, the heroes saved the day again, and the villain is defeated! Of course, there's still my sister...

But wait, there is something I don't understand...
Learn information from Alice and go to Hirkalla.

I don't know how to explain this, !

In short, I know this Alyosha. And - I don't know THIS Alyosha. You see, I met him back in the Old Era. He was the leader of the Order of Stars, a famous sage and scholar. And he had a completely different biography.

This Alyosha knows nothing about that. You think someone is impersonating him?

If only it were that simple! There are other discrepancies... It's like another world, a parallel reality where everything happened differently. The history was rewritten...
It's time to find out what's going on here, in the capital of shadows.

What a guest! And they have news!

It's too bad my sister isn't with you. There is a nice cell waiting for her.
What a strange thing to hear! Is there a force that can change someone's destiny? Alice told me you had certain abilities. That you are a Weaver! Perhaps you'll tell me about your adventures?
h: Alice says your destiny was changed

t:
Yes, I believe the awakened can do without our help for now. We have dealt with the worst trouble for now - Tep.

We need to find out who has stolen peoples' destinies! I'm sure we'll find an answer to this question in Hirkalla's palace. Her generals receive reports from all over the allod. If anything strange has happened, they'll know of it.
h: Or you'll help me find the one who changes destinies?

t: I can't believe it. I run my hands over my body but still can't get used to it.

We have no time for such small matters, . You see what's happening around us - nihilists who reject any authority are becoming more and more numerous. If you remember what we heard at Famusov's estate, then you understand - this is the result of Alice's actions...

I'm afraid the uprising might be inevitable, and things will be rough on Jigran. This may interfere with our search, and therefore we should talk to her and learn more about her plans. Perhaps even dissuade her? But how can we find her, you ask?

I've heard something. We can find her in Firezovka, a neighboring district. There's also another "odd person out" in the area...

Ah, there you are! Have you learned anything?

Ah, nihilists... Don't tell me they're wrong! My sister promised a universal resurrection, but she was able to resurrect only a few - mainly the former nobility... The poor are doomed to remain ghosts, and they don't like it...

This is our chance! Like other deities, my sister depends on faith in her. If we shake faith in her power, she will become weaker. Hirkalla herself did that often - she confused the minds, poisoned the thoughts of the people of other worlds, turning them against the All-Mother.

I will answer in kind!

And we will solve your problem ourselves - here is Iaver Bazar, a famous scientist. His fate was also stolen and now he wants to figure out how it was done! Look what he's already managed to assemble - a new Sparkton Pack! Try it out when you have time.
Playing with fate is a dangerous thing, but playing with luck is even more dangerous!
Complete three quests from Pyotr Verkhovensky.

Right now, Iaver Bazar is busy preparing for the next experiment... But since you are here, I hope you can help us organize the future uprising. The nihilists have a leader. He is standing right here: Pyotr Verkhovensky.

I'm instructing you and Alyosha to carry out his tasks. When you are done, return to us, we will figure out what happened to these destinies.

Our efforts will bear fruit over time! However, , if the nihilists start causing trouble for you - deal with them, we only need them to overthrow my sister!
Now is not the time for doubts!
A nihilist is a person who does not bow down to any authority, who does not accept any principle on faith, no matter how respected this principle might be.

It's time to spread ideas! Many of the citizens of Dar Ulgorn are already ours, they just do not know it. Previously, it was believed that crime was madness, and now crime is no longer madness, but common sense. Almost a duty or a noble cause at the very least.

Put up these posters, ! We call for an uprising! Listen, I have counted them all: those who deny the gods are with us, those who justify crimes are with ours - there are many of us, they just don't know it yet!
The main thing is to fill their minds with our ideas.

All this is necessary for the systematic shaking of the foundations, disintegration of society and all principles! To dispirit everyone and turn everything into mush, and to take the society, shaken and sickly, cynical and unbelieving, into our own hands, raising the banner of rebellion.
Find 4 loyal nihilists and eliminate 8 reluctant nihilists, then deal with the traitor Ivan Shatov.

Imagine a picture of Sarnaut, covered with an endless network of knots.

Each of these centers of activity, proselytizing and ramifying endlessly, aims by systematic denunciation to injure the prestige of local authority, to reduce the villages to confusion, to spread cynicism and scandals, together with complete disbelief in everything and an eagerness for something better, and finally, by means of fires, as a pre-eminently national method, to reduce the country at a given moment, if need be, to desperation.

Those who are hesitant should be rooted out and eliminated. Do you understand what I'm saying, ?
Listen to this: to get rid of evil, we need to destroy everything. This is the basic principle: universal destruction for the greater good, the beautiful Sarnaut of the future.
I wish it would all start soon!

Another matter that my wife must not hear about... It's about this man, Pyotr Verkhovensky, who has great influence on her, so she can't see his treacherous nature.

I know Verkhovensky is the leader of other nihilists... Fortunately, his methods are questionable, so we need to find those who have doubts about him. I want to win them over to our side.

, talk to them and try to bribe them...
Are you done with the task?
Have you managed to brib... err, I mean persuade certain nihilists? Excellent!
Obtain 4 alchemical components from Flaming and Ghostly Elementals, then assemble them into 2 devices.

We will cause such discord that every foundation will crack. We will proclaim destruction... Oh, this idea is so appealing! We will start fires... And a revolt will begin! The world has never seen such force and fury...

First, we need material... Of great explosive power... It will burn... Burn! The power of the Paladins and the false goddess turns into elementals - get their essence, . We'll need it.
Oh, let the generation grow up! Sadly there is no time to wait, otherwise we'd let them get even more drunk!

In our society, all members watch each other and must report anything suspicious. Each belongs to all, and all to each. All slaves are equal in slavery. Equality is the most important thing. Have you got what I asked for?
Obtain 10 measures of Dark Essence from Distorted Banshees.

We still have many ridiculous issues. It's because we can't look at the matter objectively - everyone brings something of their own into it, which is unnecessary.

We need to find out why - it's what we must do. A great cause is worth sacrificing for, so put your emotions aside and listen, : my research requires essence which is easier to obtain from banshees.

 I hope their cries don't bother you. Get me the essence.

Excellent. You did well. Not everyone on this allod was reborn as a ghost - some were so dark in life that death turned them into an unholy creature. Death's an old joke, but each individual encounters it anew.
Obtain 10 measures of Dark Essence from Distorted Banshees.

Our city is facing a new threat – Distorted Banshees, sinister creatures that bring destruction and fear. We need dark essence for Iaver Bazar's experiments to help him develop an effective remedy against this thing.

I ask you, , to obtain this dark essence. Together we can prevent new attacks of banshees and protect our city from evil.

Let's join forces and show them that we won't stand for the fear and destruction they create. Let the light defeat the darkness!
Do you have the essence? Great! Excellent result!

You have to remove obstacles that hinder your work. Only then can you hope to achieve even a modicum of success.

I'm extremely bothered by the centipedes living in this yard. On top of everything else, they've decided to steal my materials. I don't know why these creatures need them.

The solution is simple: exterminate the centipedes, - it will speed up my work significantly.
Don't hesitate. Only fools and smart alecks hesitate. And I don't consider you smart.
I stick to the negative direction because I feel like it. I like to deny, that's how my brain works - and that's it!
Light 3 steles in the correct order.

Excellent, . I hope you are ready to assist me. Forget all the nonsense, it's pointless to think about someone's pretty eyes. It is all romanticism, nonsense, rottenness. Only the existing reality has meaning.

You will need to light the steles in a correct order. Yellow, purple, blue. I hope you don't make a mistake, the consequences may be unpleasant.
What's the point of talking and thinking about the future which doesn't depend on us for the most part?
A good start. We will continue soon, step by step. First, we need to clear the place.
Mix different essences to get the 7 potions needed to split the Spark.

What is a Spark? No one knows for sure. Not even Tep who has spent years studying them.

My theory is this: the Spark itself is a composite entity. And it can be divided into parts. That's what we'll try to do. I assume that what you call fate is a certain component. I have already measured my own Spark. Now we will compare its parameters with the control sample.

But first we need new Spark Separators, .
The process requires precise dosing, so be careful.
Great, we've got the components we need. However, before we begin the final experiment, we need to deal with some urgent business.
Complete 3 quests from Alice together with Iaver Bazar.

Alice reminded me of unfinished business that requires my attention,  That's why we'll go together.

You can hear the details from her. We also need to have enough Spark energy to continue our research.
How is it going? Are you done yet?
Are you done? Great! I can't wait to find out what's going on with those Sparks...
Take part in a duel and deal with Pavel Kirsanov and his servants. Talk to Iaver Bazar and bring him with you, or Pavel Kirsanov will not show up to the duel.

Ahem! Oh, this Iaver Bazar... You see, there are few Zem on Jigran, . They can't be resurrected by my sister, because their Sparks were never in Nihaz's box - they are languishing in Tep's Pyramid. Only a few cultists who died in the recent war with Tep turned into ghosts...

That is why the Zem are extremely critical of Hirkalla and everything she does. Our friend is a skeptic and a nihilist who says everything right to your face. Alas, many take issue with it, and among them is a local nobleman - Pavel Kirsanov, the uncle of one of Bazar's students.

He demanded a duel. He also brought servants with him. You will have to deal with them. You'll be my friend's second.
I think Mr. Kirsanov will have time to consider his behavior... This entire family should be avoided.
Take part in a duel and deal with Pavel Kirsanov and his servants.

Ahem! Oh, this Iaver Bazar... You see, there are few Zem on Jigran. They can't be resurrected by my sister, because their Sparks were never in Nihaz's box - they are languishing in Tep's Pyramid. Only a few cultists who died in the recent war with Tep turned into ghosts...

That is why the Zem are extremely critical of Hirkalla and everything she does. Our friend is a skeptic and a nihilist who says everything right to your face. Alas, many take issue with it, and among them is a local nobleman - Pavel Kirsanov, the uncle of one of Bazar's students.

He demanded a duel. He also brought servants with him. You will have to deal with them. You'll be my friend's second.
I think Mr. Kirsanov will have time to consider his behavior... This entire family should be avoided.
Collect four different parts of smart zombies. Talk to Iaver Bazar and bring him with you so he can identify the real zombies.

In his spare time, our friend is busy constructing cadavers – zombies assembled from body parts of different people.

Unfortunately, the latest batch of zombies turned out to be unusually smart and nimble. Now they are wandering around the neighborhood, scaring civilians.

We want to take them apart to recover the most valuable parts, so find them and... do that. Iaver Bazar will show you the zombies you need, , so you don't dismember random passersby.
They are a little too clever. I'll tell Bazar to be careful.
Oh, excellent... Give them here, it's hard to find decent parts for zombies these days. No one dies now...
Collect 4 different cadaver parts for Iaver Bazar.

I have another request for you, , because my wife has informed me of another threat to our region. It is posed by the zombies created by Iaver Bazaar. My wife asks that we take the zombies apart and return them to Iaver Bazaar.

These zombies are mindless, dangerous creatures. They threaten our residents, deface our city, and create chaos. We cannot handle them on our own, and so we turn to you, heroes, to help us neutralize this threat.

Help us protect our region and our people from this sinister invasion. I understand that my wife is right, and I cannot allow these zombies to cause damage to our society. Help us, and I will be grateful to you for the rest of my days. Help us get rid of this threat and restore peace in our city.
Have you collected all the parts? I should try to combine them differently.
Retrieve 8 books that belonged to Yaver Bazar. Whether you pay for them or simply take them is up to you.

, many people come here, including nihilists... They often take books from Iaver Bazar and then don't return them!

This is an outrage and I suggest punishing them... We need to get the books back - I'm sure they can be found where such people usually gather.
I don't know who exactly took the books, but they need to be retrieved!
We taught them a little lesson - and that's fine, they'll be resurrected soon anyway. We'll need the books to complete the experiments.
Collect 10 books that belonged to Yaver Bazar.

The scholar Iaver Bazar had a few valuable books taken from him recently. , I ask you to return the missing books to Iaver Bazar, because these books are of great importance not only to our city, but also to our future. They contain knowledge that can change the course of history and bring prosperity to our society.

As a free spirit, I believe in the power of education. We cannot afford to lose these things. So I call on you, my dear heroes, to help us find these books and return them to their rightful owner.
Do you have the books? Excellent news.
Conduct an experiment with Iaver Bazar to discover fate by following his instructions.

Well, we've solved our problems, it's time for our experiment. They say that on allods with no metals people use rocks. They hit them against each other to break them and get sharp chips...

My method is quite similar - I will divide the Spark into parts to create my own tools. With them, I will continue to divide the experimental entity, and then I'll put it back together. Interested, ? So am I.

Hah, a half-educated scientist. He thinks he has learned more about the Spark than Tep himself... But he's far from the great necromancer whose name is still remembered with horror.

However, his information is not useless. So... The Scissors have appeared in our world - the power that cuts the great Pattern of Destiny. A change in one place affects the picture as a whole. The Scissors want to nullify what you managed to do.

This power is beyond the imagination of mortals. One who masters it will rise not just above the gods... above the demiurges!

I have an idea for a potion that can only be brewed here, on Jigran, where everything is saturated with dark and ghostly emanations... The effects of this elixir can be very unusual! But the goal of science is to conduct tests!

If you are ready to assist me in extracting resources, then I'm happy to supply you with it for free. Just follow my instructions, .
It's simple. The potion has a wide range of applications - you are tasked with testing it. Try using it on various creatures.
Ask Alice what the nihilists are doing, and then choose which side to support.

I suppose you need to find Alice first... I doubt she's left the place we last found her.

, find her and learn her plans!
Anyway, take this... You'll need it soon...
Glad to hear it! But this choice will affect the future, so you need to be absolutely sure of it!
h: You're right, let's put an end to Hirkalla's rule!

t: You won't regret it! Now listen carefully...
It pains me to hear this... But I'll ask again. This choice will affect the future, so you need to be absolutely sure of it!
h: Hirkalla is right, and you've gone mad!

t: I think you'll regret this... Get out of my sight! Go to her...
Begone! Get out! And don't think I'll forget this...

It's probably naive to expect gratitude from your world, but I've managed without large-scale atrocities so far. Foolish people always expect bloodshed from me, as though I have nothing better to do than to flog someone... Yes, Cosmos and the Sculptor did not swear allegiance to me, and Aidenus and Yasker are scheming behind my back, but I'm not going to raze your capitals to the ground.

I wanted to help you fulfill your potential. But you decided to play dirty.

Well, no one is perfect, . I will still root out the Light.
Win the battle for the Cathedral by eliminating 30 common enemies and 3 generals.

Our plan is simple: the shield of faith around the Cathedral has finally collapsed, and Hirkalla has sent in her guard and generals!

Pyotr Verkhovensky is also leading his people there at this very moment. Together, the Paladins and nihilists will be able to crush my sister's forces with their sheer numbers. Yes, they're not fond of each other, but they will unite to end the reign of the dark goddess.

Hirkalla will have to intervene - and that would be my cue. I expect that she will be noticeably weakened by then.

, your task is to help crush her troops and generals.

Stop! Stop!

The Light sent me a vision – we must stop this battle. Something terrible is approaching... To the Cathedral, quickly!
Win the battle for the Cathedral by eliminating 30 common enemies and 3 generals.

My plan is simple: the shield of faith around the Cathedral is about to collapse - it's time to send in my guard and generals.

There are also nihilists from all over the city gathering near the Cathedral together with their leader, Pyotr Verkhovensky. Paladins and nihilists became temporary allies who intend to overwhelm my forces with sheer numbers. We'll get rid of them all in one strike!

Then Alice will have to intervene - that would be my cue. Little sister will go back to Mother to take a break from her scheming.

, your task is to help crush the nihilists and Paladins by eliminating their leaders.

Stop! Stop!

The Light sent me a vision – we must stop this battle. Something terrible is approaching... To the Cathedral, quickly!
You see various ammunition. There are discharged Sparkbooms here - you can spend Spark energy to recharge them and use them in combat. You will need at least 10 measures of Spark energy.
Find out what's going on in the Cathedral.

The two goddesses are fighting in the Cathedral... but that's not the problem. Something has changed in our world... The world has changed!

I don't understand what's happening, ... We should ask the Children of Light...
The Children of Light will not protect us. The new Lord of Death is a threat even to Enod! They will retreat to defend it. Now we are alone... Was our faith false?

, I don't know how the most dangerous necromancer of our world hid under the guise of Alyosh, and why he was resurrected at all if you had destroyed him in Tep's Pyramid, but your capital should hear about this.

It's time for me to turn to the inhabitants of Sarnaut. If the Children of Light are right, then Tep, who has become a God, is a threat to all worlds.

Talk to Alice and Hirkalla - it seems their powers have diminished... Perhaps Tep will reconcile the irreconcilable.

Oh, , I can sense that something has happened...

Perhaps the Aoidoi call you the Stormbringer for a reason? You haven't brought any good news lately. Tell me everything from the beginning...

...

Well... it would be stupid to blame you for what happened. I would hold the two goddesses responsible. Two capricious girls who received their powers by chance.

However, the prophecy of Seida, which I carefully studied after discovering Isa, has these lines:

"Light and darkness in battle

Argue with each other,

But in vain:

Their fate is inevitable.

A new god will rise -

He who took the power

From the unfortunate sisters

Who forgot the law:

What Fate decides

Will happen.

There is no power in the world,

That would change that."

Was it all predetermined? Perhaps our enemy is not even Tep... but Destiny itself?

, I don't know how the most dangerous necromancer of our world hid under the guise of Alyosh, and why he was resurrected at all if you had destroyed him in Tep's Pyramid, but your capital should hear about this.

...

However, the prophecy of Seida, which I carefully studied after discovering Isa, has these lines:

Argue with each other,

But in vain:

Their fate is inevitable.

A new god will rise -

He who took the power

From the unfortunate sisters

Who forgot the law:

What Fate decides

Will happen.

There is no power in the world,

That would change that."

Was it all predetermined? Perhaps our enemy is not even Tep... but Destiny itself?
Ask the civil governor Andrey Lemkov how he can help.

Hirkalla's authority is shaken, , but the people of Jigran need support. While these two goddesses are regaining their strength and preparing to go after Tep, power in Jigran will pass to the civilian governor named Andrey Lemkov. He's a man of the people, and he also needs help. Your help.

Go to him and find out what you cancan do.

Oh, are we on our own now?

We have enough problems: ghostly and corrupted creatures still threaten the city, and the guard fights them. The undead are becoming unruly! The nihilists still deny authority and thirst for revenge! On the edge of the allod, in Sadrok, something unthinkable is happening. The newly arrived expedition of the Arisen has excavated some ruins of their people... There are many problems. Fortunately, I have my wife and you, my glorious heroes.
Go to the Fortecia that lies to the northwest of the city and find Maxim Maximov.

, it seems that our empress doesn't know about those who create "odd people out"... and even Dark Maidens have nothing to do with it. But apparently those deprived of fate attract these parasites somehow.

It looks like the force that erases people's fates acts independently of Darkness and Light. Very interesting. I hope we'll meet them sooner or later... Now we need to find the next victim we were told about... We're heading to a small fortress that guards the approaches to the city. We will talk to the commandant and learn where we can find them.
If we hurry, we'll increase our chances of finding the right person.

Hello, dear guests. I am Maxim Maximov, my father was also Maxim, so feel free to call me Maxim Maksimovich. On behalf of our sovereign I hold this fortress, otherwise known as the Fortecia.

Many threats hang over Dar Ulgorn: ghostly creatures, dark shadows, and... the Orcs! One tribe, the Montane, has risen again. They now terrorize the area. Of course, not all of them are savage. You can even have a conversation with some... But you need to keep an eye on the whole clan.

And what do you need here? Oh, you're looking for that man? Grigory Pechorin? He just left... Well, since you are waiting for him anyway, maybe you can help? Because there are never enough people...
Interesting things are happening here, in Hirkalla's court...

Here we have the hottest spot in all of Jigran: there's the undead army in the northeast and southwest, mountains to the southeast, and swamps with all sorts of nasty things nearby.

One of the worst troubles for us is the ghosts of various creatures. And the most unpleasant and aggressive right now are scorpions. , I task you with killing a dozen of these creatures so we can breathe easy here.
It's a fierce beast - weapons barely make a scratch, but the sting is as painful as the live one's.
How nice! A lot of animals have become ghosts – will they come back to life?

My wife has convinced me that the ghostly scorpions near the Fortecia pose a serious threat to our region. These creatures are dangerous and elusive. Their attacks spoil our peaceful existence. We cannot handle this threat on our own, so we ask you, , to help us protect our city and its surroundings.

Help us get rid of these ghostly scorpions and restore peace in the region.

I understand that my wife is right, and I cannot allow these creatures to cause even more harm to our society. Help us, and I'll be grateful to you for the rest of my days.
Are the Scorpions dead? A fine deed!
Use mines to eliminate 10 Distorted Killer Hares.

Another problem are those damned rabbits! Or hares? Who knows... A terrible beast...

How dangerous can a rabbit really be, right? But here's the thing, ... Each of these rabbits will try to jump into your arms... And then explode with terrible force, and that's sure death!

So they can only be killed from a distance... Or better yet, with special mines. I'll give you a few...

And if you want some advice from an old warrior - if you see a rabbit, give it a wide berth! Better safe than sorry.
Jigran kamikaze rabbits... Everyone knows about them, everyone fears them...

Oh, you survived? Thank all the gods. I thought you would perish there, among the rabbits... or hares? Who knows...

But now there are fewer of them.
Use mines to eliminate 10 Distorted Killer Hares.

My wife is a strong-willed, liberal woman. She always supports me, but her influence on me is undeniable. And now I stand before you, asking for help, because my wife insists that we get rid of the killer rabbits that threaten our fort.

These killer rabbits are dangerous creatures that attack our fortifications. We cannot handle them on our own, so we ask you, , to help us eliminate this threat.

Help us protect our Fortecia, our territory, our people.
Killer hares are gone? Good news for all travelers!
Eliminate 10 Ghostly Crawlers and 10 of their eggs.

There are troubles of today and troubles of tomorrow. That's what I think. Today's troubles are the damned scorpions and the crazy rabbits, and tomorrow's troubles are the ghostly crawlers.

These creatures have begun to multiply somehow... A miracle of miracles, but it will be very bad for us if they continue to do so.

So, let's thin their numbers a little, ... Destroy the eggs, kill the ghostly crawlers...
By some miracle the dead Crawlers began to multiply. Even the Great Mages can't explain this...
Well, there are fewer Crawlers now, and destroyed eggs mean there will be even fewer of them tomorrow...
Eliminate 10 Ghostly Crawlers and 10 of their eggs.

My wife has convinced me that the ghostly Crawlers near the fort pose a serious threat to our region. She has instructed me that it's important to destroy not just the Crawlers but also their eggs. I know this is a difficult task, but I believe in your abilities and your honor. Help us get rid of this threat and protect our residents.

We cannot handle this threat on our own, so we ask you, , to help us protect our city.
The Crawlers and their eggs are all gone? That's great news!
Help Grigory Pechorin steal a rhino from an orc village.

Maxim Maksimovich said you were looking for me, gentlemenlady and gentleman? Do you want to hear my confession... Well, I confess that I never reveal my secrets, but I love it terribly when someone guesses them, because then I can always deny it...

However, since you are willing to help me, perhaps I'll tell you what happened...

We had a bet and now I need to deliver - to steal a beast from an orc village. I will distract them and you will do the rest, . Bring the beast to the bridge, we'll settle the score then.
Remember, we meet at the bridge.

Hah, I see it all worked out... Yes, I didn't tell you everything, but did you really need to know it all in advance?

Whether I am a fool or a villain I know not; but this is certain, I am also most deserving of pity – perhaps more than she. My soul has been spoiled by the world, my imagination is unquiet, my heart insatiate. Nothing is enough for me: I get used to sadness as easily as to pleasure, and my life becomes emptier day by day.

As for talking, I'm not currently in the mood. We'll talk later. Help my comrades for now, maybe something will come of it.
Use Spark energy to charge 5 generators that repel hostile creatures.

Our Fortecia is a bur in the throat for the nearby creatures. A large number of ghostly and distorted creatures pass through the area. If they attack all at once, we are finished.

To prevent this from happening, we have special contraptions on the walls that need to be charged with Spark energy. , I ask you to check them. If they are out of juice, recharge them.
If the generators don't work, all the hostile creatures that live to the west of the city will be drawn here.
Excellent! Thank you for your service. We can hold out for a while, and then – I hope – reinforcements will arrive...
Use Spark energy to charge 5 generators that repel hostile creatures.

We are faced with the threat of dark creatures that attack the city from the side of Fortecia. But fortunately, we have special generators that repel these sinister creatures. But for this we need your help, .

Please go to the Fortecia and charge the special generators to protect our capital from these creatures. I believe your courage and strength will help us overcome this threat. Good luck to you, heroes!
Are the generators charged? That means the fortress will hold out for a while longer!

There's something ominous in the air around our fortress, ...

I suppose it's the heralds of darkness, dark shadows that roam the ruined courtyards of the city... I don't know where they come from, but they seem to be sucking all the joy and happiness around us.

Disperse them if you have time, will you?
If a shadow is lurking nearby, nothing will go well – that's what my grandfather used to say.
Oh, I'm already feeling better! Please accept my gratitude, otherwise we would've had to provide liquor for everyone here.

We are faced with a new threat: dark creatures and shadows started attacking our city. My husband is incapable of dealing with this evil, so he turned to me. And I, Julia Lemkova, decided to come up with some countermeasures.

I ask you, , to go to the fort near the city and deal with these wandering shadows. We cannot allow them to threaten our peace and order. Your courage and strength are needed to defeat this darkness.

I believe in your ability to overcome this threat and protect our city. Good luck to you, dear heroes, and may your courage bring us victory!
The shadows are gone? Life will be easier for a while...
Hand out 8 rations to hungry soldiers.

Oh, what a bad time for our cook to fall ill... He went to gather some herbs and came across a rabbit... No, he'll live, but he won't be able to cook for a while...

I suppose we'll have to switch to dry rations! The people will be unhappy, of course. But what can we do...

Hand out some rations, . Let them eat... And we'll think of something later. Maybe Pechorin's girl should cook...
People need to eat. A hungry warrior is useless!
Excellent! Everyone has been fed, which means the Fortecia is ready to repel attacks... They say there's an orc bandit prowling around the area, seeking revenge on those who stole his rhino...
Hand out 10 rations to hungry soldiers in the Fortecia

Our city needs your help, . Our brave soldiers are ready to defend the city from the onslaught of dark creatures. Alas, it's not always possible to provide them with everything they need. There is now a shortage of supplies. But there is a solution.

Today I suggest you feed our soldiers with dry rations. Let this simple but nutritious meal help them maintain their strength in the fight against evil.
Have you fed the soldiers? That means they'll hold out long enough for us to solve the food issue.
Oh, I could use a little pick-me-up...
Oh, thank you! It's better than nothing...
I could use some hot soup...
I wish I had some oranges...
I wouldn't say no to a rabbit for dinner...
Our fortress has everything, if they deliver it on time... But, of course, we don't always have enough supplies - the surrounding lands are too barren...
Fight three duels as Grigory Pechorin's second.

Are you ready?

I prefer to doubt everything. Such a disposition does not preclude a resolute character. On the contrary, as far as I am concerned, I always advance more boldly when I don't know what is waiting me for me. After all, nothing worse than death can happen - and death you can't escape! And if people would only reason a little more, they would be convinced that life is not worth being so troubled about.

I hate people to avoid despising them because otherwise, life would become too disgusting a farce. Some consider me worse, others better than I am. Some will say he was a good fellow; others, a scoundrel. And both will be wrong. After all this, is life worth the trouble? And yet we live - out of curiosity! We expect something new... How absurd, and yet how vexatious!

, will you be my second? Certain gentlemen believe I insulted them, therefore we must meet with them. Two against two. Three times. If you agree, we'll become friends.

There are two personalities within me: one lives – in the complete sense of the word – the other reflects and judges him; the first, it may be, in an hour's time, will take farewell of you and the world for ever, and the second...

Mine is an unfortunate disposition; whether it is the result of my upbringing or whether it is innate – I know not. I only know this, that if I am the cause of unhappiness in others I myself am no less unhappy. Of course, that is a poor consolation to them – only the fact remains that such is the case.

How was it I did not see that lofty sky before? And how happy I am to have found it at last! Yes! All is vanity, all falsehood, except that infinite sky. There is nothing, nothing, but that. There is nothing but quiet and peace.
Find Brick the Montane and try to save Squirrel the Montane

Ah yes, while you and I were shedding other people's blood, an Orc woman was kidnapped... I suppose it was our avenger whose rhino we stole... Should we find him now? What do you think, ?

I sometimes despise myself... Is that because I despise others, too?

What is sad, we laugh at; what is laughable, we grieve at; but, to tell the truth, we are fairly indifferent, generally speaking, to everything except ourselves. Again I was mistaken; the love of a savage is little better than that of your lady of quality, the barbaric ignorance and simplicity of the one weary you as much as the coquetry of the other. I am not saying that I do not love her still; I am grateful to her for a few fairly sweet moments; I would give my life for her—only I am bored with her...

Over me the word "marry" has a kind of magical power. However passionately I love a woman, if she only gives me to feel that I have to marry her – then farewell, love! My heart is turned to stone, and nothing will warm it anew. I am prepared for any other sacrifice but that; my life twenty times over, nay, my honor I would stake on the fortune of a card... but my freedom I will never sell.
I feel like we're getting closer to solving the mystery. Each of them lost something important, something that made them a different person... A stranger? Interesting... Let's try to find out more.
Find out what Grigory Pechorin can do for you as a companion.
What a glorious battle! We hussars are always ready to brandish our sabers! And my friends with whom we've made peace are the fiercest fighters in Jigran!
